name: Lukas Dubois
headline: Mobile Engineer
summary: Mobile engineer with a track record of building and improving customer-facing apps across native and cross-platform teams. Experienced in shipping polished mobile experiences, coordinating releases, and partnering with product and design to improve reliability and user satisfaction.

roles.title: Junior Software Engineer
bullets: Built onboarding and account flows in SwiftUI, then used Redux to keep state handling predictable across screens.
Reduced interface churn by 28% by tightening shared mobile patterns and simplifying data updates in SwiftUI and Redux.
Partnered with designers and backend teams to deliver cleaner navigation and faster feature rollouts for the mobile app.

roles.title: Mobile Engineer
bullets: Delivered new app features in Dart for React Native screens while supporting the native iOS experience.
Improved release stability by 34% by refactoring shared mobile flows and removing duplicate logic across Dart, Java and React Native.
Worked with product stakeholders to prioritize fixes, polish key journeys and keep the mobile app on schedule.

roles.title: Senior Mobile Engineer
bullets: Led delivery of mobile features using Agile practices, coordinating CI/CD checks, Git workflows and review cycles for a cross-functional team.
Built shared app screens in Flutter and Jetpack Compose, while integrating GraphQL and REST APIs in Dart, Kotlin, Swift and iOS modules.
Raised release confidence by adding JUnit coverage and tightening build validation, cutting post-release defects by 22%.
Guided the team through architecture decisions for mobile state handling, faster delivery and cleaner handoff between app layers.
Partnered with designers and backend engineers to ship 6 major updates with smoother sync, clearer error handling and better performance.
